purpose: Metadata-only, non-exhaustive curator-reviewed initial membership and reference-context catalogue for future M8 snapshots.
curation_decision_scope: Accession.version metadata membership in distinct panel roles; not candidate classification, sequence validation, legal clearance, or authorization to redistribute sequence payloads.
human_review_required_scope: Record-specific source terms and redistribution must still be checked before materialized sequence snapshots; this flag does not mean curator membership is undecided.
taxonomy_provenance: NCBI E-utilities summary and Taxonomy summary queried on 2026-09-26; live metadata, not an archived taxonomy snapshot.

entries.record_title: Cucumber mosaic virus satellite RNA, complete genome

sequence_metadata.segment_identity: single satellite RNA molecule; not a numbered CMV genomic segment

entries.source_sequence_status: Public NCBI record found; sequence bytes were not retrieved or included.
entries.curation_rationale: Representative small plant satellite RNA; retained as a distinct role from satellite viruses and DNA satellites.

helper_evidence.association: Experimentally established for the CMV satellite-RNA system.
helper_evidence.dependence: Replication depends on helper-virus functions; exact helper isolate paired with this reference accession is unresolved.

redistribution.decision: Manifest and provenance only by default; review exact record and linked-source terms before any sequence redistribution.

review_notes: Approved as a starter representative; the CMV helper relationship is system-level and no exact helper isolate is assigned.

entries.record_title: Panicum mosaic satellite virus, complete genome

sequence_metadata.segment_identity: single complete satellite-virus genomic RNA; not segmented

entries.source_sequence_status: Public NCBI record found; sequence bytes were not retrieved or included.
entries.curation_rationale: Representative plant satellite virus with its own capsid-protein coding region; keep distinct from noncoding satellite RNAs.

helper_evidence.helper: Panicum mosaic virus (PMV), taxid 40279; contextual RefSeq NC_002598.1
helper_evidence.dependence: Experimental work reports dependence on PMV for replication and spread; PMV-encoded RNA polymerase supports replication.

redistribution.decision: Manifest and provenance only by default; review exact record and linked-source terms before any sequence redistribution.

review_notes: PMV is a supported helper at the species/system level; do not infer that the PMV contextual reference accession is the exact isolate used in every cited experiment.

entries.record_title: Satellite tobacco necrosis virus 1 genome including reading frame for the viral coat protein

sequence_metadata.strandedness: Not returned by the queried NCBI summary; literature describes a positive-sense ssRNA satellite virus.
sequence_metadata.segment_identity: single satellite-virus genomic RNA; not segmented
sequence_metadata.record_completeness: Not returned by NCBI ESummary; the accession title does not establish completeness.

entries.source_sequence_status: Public NCBI/INSDC record found; sequence bytes were not retrieved or included.
entries.curation_rationale: Represents a satellite virus with its own coat-protein coding region. Preserve the current taxonomy name separately from the legacy virus name in the accession title.

helper_evidence.helper: Members of ICTV genera Alphanecrovirus or Betanecrovirus (family Tombusviridae); no exact helper accession or isolate assigned.
helper_evidence.association: ICTV describes helper dependence for the satellite-virus group.
helper_evidence.dependence: Group-level replication dependence is supported; an exact helper accession/isolate pairing for V01468.1 is not established.

redistribution.decision: Manifest and provenance only by default; review exact record and linked-source terms before any sequence redistribution.

review_notes: Preserve the historical accession title and current Albetovirus alphatabaci name separately; ESummary does not establish completeness or an exact helper isolate.

entries.record_title: Cotton leaf curl Multan betasatellite c1 gene

sequence_metadata.strandedness: Not returned by the queried NCBI summary; primary literature describes the betasatellite class as ssDNA.
sequence_metadata.segment_identity: single circular satellite DNA molecule; not segmented
sequence_metadata.record_completeness: Complete record indicated by NCBI summary.

entries.source_sequence_status: Public NCBI/INSDC record found; sequence bytes were not retrieved or included.
entries.curation_rationale: Provides a DNA-satellite architecture distinct from RNA satellites and satellite viruses.

helper_evidence.helper: Cotton leaf curl Multan virus and other compatible begomoviruses; no single helper accession assigned.
helper_evidence.association: Experimentally established for the disease-associated DNA-beta system.
helper_evidence.dependence: Trans-replication by Cotton leaf curl Multan virus was reported; compatibility with additional begomoviruses does not establish one exclusive helper.

redistribution.decision: Manifest and provenance only by default; review exact record and linked-source terms before any sequence redistribution.

review_notes: NCBI links this accession to PMID 11437658 and reports a complete circular record; the older ICTV list's AJ292769 is not assumed to be sequence-identical.

entries.source_sequence_status: Public NCBI record found; sequence bytes were not retrieved or included.
entries.curation_rationale: A distinct deltavirus comparator, not a plant satellite class. Current ICTV places Deltavirus in Kolmioviridae; older literature sometimes describes HDV as a satellite agent.

helper_evidence.helper: Hepatitis B virus (HBV); contextual reference NC_003977.2.
helper_evidence.association: Experimentally established for envelope acquisition and particle formation; ICTV notes in-vitro evidence for other helper viruses.
helper_evidence.dependence: HBV surface antigen is needed for virion envelopment/transmission; HDV RNA replication itself is not described as requiring HBV.

redistribution.decision: Manifest and provenance only by default; review exact record and linked-source terms before any sequence redistribution.

review_notes: Keep the Deltavirus role separate from plant satellite RNA, satellite virus, and satellite DNA subroles.

entries.record_title: Potato spindle tuber viroid, complete genome

sequence_metadata.segment_identity: single viroid RNA molecule; not segmented

entries.source_sequence_status: Public NCBI record found; sequence bytes were not retrieved or included.
entries.curation_rationale: A related subviral RNA comparator, explicitly not a satellite: viroids are distinct agent classes and use host replication machinery rather than a helper virus.

helper_evidence.helper: Not applicable as a helper-virus association.
helper_evidence.dependence: Host replication machinery is distinct from helper-virus dependence.

redistribution.decision: Manifest and provenance only by default; review exact record and linked-source terms before any sequence redistribution.

review_notes: Retain the viroid role as contextual comparison, never as a satellite membership label.

sequence_metadata.segment_identity: single complete virophage genome; not segmented

entries.source_sequence_status: Public NCBI record found; sequence bytes were not retrieved or included.
entries.curation_rationale: A virophage is a distinct giant-virus-dependent agent; it is useful related context but not equivalent to plant satellite RNA or DNA classes.

helper_evidence.helper: Acanthamoeba polyphaga mimivirus/mamavirus experimental system; exact helper accession/isolate pairing is not asserted for this RefSeq record.
helper_evidence.association: Experimentally established by co-infection and replication in the giant-virus factory.
helper_evidence.dependence: The original study reports that Sputnik does not multiply in amoebae alone and grows in cells co-infected with the giant virus.

redistribution.decision: Manifest and provenance only by default; review exact record and linked-source terms before any sequence redistribution.

review_notes: The RefSeq record is linked to PMID 18690211, whose paper cites EU606015.1; sequence equivalence was not checked, so preserve both accessions separately.

sequence_metadata.strandedness: Not returned by the queried NCBI summary.
sequence_metadata.segment_identity: single record; NCBI summary identifies genome class as proviral
sequence_metadata.record_completeness: Complete genome stated in record title.

entries.source_sequence_status: Public NCBI/INSDC record found; sequence bytes were not retrieved or included.
entries.curation_rationale: Virophage/proviral context illustrates endogenous or integrated forms; the record must not be treated as an ordinary free virophage genome without source review.

helper_evidence.helper: Cafeteria roenbergensis virus (CroV) in experimental Mavirus systems.
helper_evidence.association: Virophage association is described in primary literature.
helper_evidence.dependence: CroV-dependent reproduction/reactivation is supported in Mavirus experimental systems; this exact accession is proviral, not a free-virus isolate.

redistribution.decision: Manifest and provenance only by default; review exact record and linked-source terms before any sequence redistribution.

review_notes: Approved only as explicitly proviral context; do not present this accession as a free-virus Mavirus isolate.
